summary.text: ELITE PROSJEKT AS is a private limited company registered in Strømmen, founded 2017-09-13. ELITE PROSJEKT AS is registered to construct and maintain commercial buildings, including conversion and rehabilitation work. It was previously named ELITE GRUPPEN AS until 2019-01-29. Its main industry code is 41.000: construction of residential and non-residential buildings. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 59 103 233 NOK and the annual result was 1 857 728 NOK; operating income was up from 34 535 478 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -2 784 682 NOK in 2024 to 1 857 728 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -3 847 652 NOK in 2024 to -1 989 924 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Espen Volla (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 20 on 2025-12-12 to 19 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
